info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Currency Exchange Consumer Service Update API enables businesses to modify existing consumer service parameters related to currency exchange. This endpoint allows consumers to update specific service settings using a unique identifier. Typical users include financial institutions and service providers who need to adapt their offerings based on changing business requirements. The API provides a streamlined approach to managing consumer service configurations efficiently and effectively.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific currency exchange resource identified by its ID. Use this operation to modify fields such as rates, currencies, or any relevant attributes of the currency exchange.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific fields of the currency exchange resource identified by RES-100045. The provided JSON object should contain the fields and their corresponding new values that need to be updated.
